title: [Analysis of a Chinese pedigree affected with Townes-Brocks syndrome due to a novel variant of SALL1 gene and a literature review].
authors: Chi, Yunqian; Sun, Futao; Zhang, Zihan; Wang, Yunhe; Hao, Wei
journal: Zhonghua yi xue yi chuan xue za zhi = Zhonghua yixue yichuanxue zazhi = Chinese journal of medical genetics
one_liner_zh: 该文报道SALL1基因新变异致Townes-Brocks综合征，虽用AlphaFold预测蛋白结构，但核心为临床遗传诊断，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To analyze a novel exonic variant of the SALL1 gene and its impact on the binding site of SALL protein. METHODS: Clinical data of three children diagnosed with Townes-Brocks syndrome and their family members who had presented at the First Affiliated Hospital of Shandong First Medical University in April 2022 were retrospectively collected. The pathogenic variant was identified through whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and validated by Sanger sequencing. Protein structural prediction was performed using AlphaFold and PyMOL software to construct three-dimensional models of the wild-type and mutant proteins. Additionally, previously reported cases were systematically reviewed. This study was approved by the Medical Ethics Committee of the hospital (Ethics No.: 2023-386). RESULTS: The proband was one of triplet sisters born at 34(+4) gestational weeks. All three cases had presented with anal atresia and rectovaginal fistula, and case 3 also had toe malformation of left foot. WGS revealed a novel heterozygous c.757C>T (p.Gln253*) variant in the SALL1 gene, which was predicted to be pathogenic. Sanger sequencing confirmed co-segregation of the variant with the disease within the family. Protein structural modeling demonstrated that the variant has introduced a premature stop codon at position 253, resulting in a truncated protein. CONCLUSION: Above finding has enriched the mutation spectrum of the SALL1 gene in association with Townes-Brocks syndrome, which also represented a rare case of anal atresia in triplets, and provided a basis for molecular diagnosis, genetic counseling, and further research.
abstract_zh: 目的：分析SALL1基因一个新的外显子变异及其对SALL蛋白结合位点的影响。方法：回顾性收集2022年4月在山东第一医科大学第一附属医院就诊的3例诊断为Townes-Brocks综合征的患儿及其家族成员的临床资料。通过全基因组测序（WGS）鉴定致病变异，并经Sanger测序验证。利用AlphaFold和PyMOL软件进行蛋白质结构预测，构建野生型及突变型蛋白的三维模型。此外，系统回顾了既往报道的病例。本研究经医院医学伦理委员会批准（伦理号：2023-386）。结果：先证者为34(+4)孕周出生的三胞胎姐妹之一。3例均表现为肛门闭锁和直肠阴道瘘，病例3还伴有左足趾畸形。WGS检测到SALL1基因一个新的杂合c.757C>T（p.Gln253*）变异，预测为致病性。Sanger测序证实该变异在家族内与疾病共分离。蛋白质结构建模显示，该变异在第253位引入提前终止密码子，导致截短蛋白的产生。结论：上述发现丰富了SALL1基因与Townes-Brocks综合征相关的突变谱，同时代表了罕见的双胞胎肛门闭锁病例，为分子诊断、遗传咨询及进一步研究提供了基础。
